# Task: Convex sync + backend for "the House" (Twyne)

Repo: /home/diogenes/Projects/twyne (Qwik + Convex, Bun). Read `CLAUDE.md` and `convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md` FIRST.

Another agent is editing UI files in this working tree at the same time. The tree also has many unrelated uncommitted changes.
- ONLY create or edit the files listed under "Files you own".
- Never reformat or revert anything else.
- Do not run `prettier --write .`, `git checkout`, `git stash`, or `git commit`.

## Context (already written; read these, do not change their exported types)
- `src/utils/house-model.ts`: types `HouseState`, `House`, `Collection`, `CharterItem`, `LedgerEntry`, plus pure stack assembly.
- `src/utils/house-store.ts`: local-first storage.
  - The whole `HouseState` lives in IDB meta key `house-state`.
  - Every change fires `window` event `twyne:house-changed` with `{ state, remote }`.
  - Write remote pulls with `replaceHouseState(state, { remote: true })` so they don't bounce back out.

## Files you own
1. **`convex/schema.ts`**: APPEND new tables only; touch nothing else.
   - Rows, not arrays (see the guidelines); index names include every field.
   - Tables:
     - `houses` { userId, name, dossier: v.any(), updatedAt }, index `by_userId`
     - `houseCollections` { userId, collectionId, name, description, dossier: v.any(), createdAt, updatedAt }, indexes `by_userId`, `by_userId_and_collectionId`
     - `collectionMembers` { userId, collectionId, folioId }, indexes `by_userId`, `by_userId_and_collectionId`, `by_userId_and_folioId`
     - `charterItems` { userId, itemId, scope: "house"|"collection"|"folio", ownerRef, text, severity: "must"|"prefer", kind: "length"|"citation"|"style"|"voice"|"other", order, updatedAt }, indexes `by_userId`, `by_userId_and_itemId`
     - `contextLedger` { userId, entryId, at, layer, ownerRef, field?, from?, to?, source, reason? }, indexes `by_userId_and_at`, `by_userId_and_entryId`
2. **`convex/house.ts`** (new). Follow the auth pattern in `convex/userComments.ts`.
   - The owner is ALWAYS `(await ctx.auth.getUserIdentity()).tokenIdentifier`. Never accept a userId argument. Throw "Not signed in" when there is no identity.
   - Validators on every arg; string fields bounded (cap lengths, reject oversize).
   - Functions:
     - `getHouse` query: returns `{ house, collections (with folioIds from collectionMembers), charter, ledger: newest 200 }` in the `HouseState` shape, or null when there is nothing.
     - `putHouseSnapshot` mutation: takes a full `HouseState`-shaped arg (ledger capped at 200 per call).
       - Upserts the house row.
       - Replaces collections, members and charter rows to match exactly (delete missing).
       - Inserts ledger entries idempotently by entryId. The ledger is append-only and never deleted by this mutation.
     - `listLedger` paginated query ordered by `at` desc.
   - Add every new table to the account-deletion map in `convex/account.ts`, following the existing entries (e.g. `userComments` near line 181).
3. **`convex/house.test.ts`** (new). Same style as `convex/userComments.test.ts` (`describeConvex`, `import.meta.glob` guard). Cover:
   - round-trip `putHouseSnapshot` → `getHouse`
   - replacing removes deleted collections and charter items
   - ledger idempotency
   - signed-out throws
   - writer B cannot see writer A's house
4. **`src/utils/house-sync.ts`** (new): `startHouseSync(getClient: () => ConvexClient | null): () => void`.
   - On start, and on `twyne:remote-sync`: query `api.house.getHouse`.
     - Merge rule: the newer `house.updatedAt` wins for house and collections, charter items merge by `updatedAt` per itemId, and ledger entries union by id.
     - Write back with `replaceHouseState(merged, { remote: true })` only when something changed.
   - On `twyne:house-changed` where `remote === false`: debounce 2s, then call `api.house.putHouseSnapshot`.
   - Fail quietly offline (retry on the `online` event).
   - Keep the merge logic a pure exported function `mergeHouseStates(local, remote)`.
   - Also `src/utils/house-sync.test.ts` (bun:test) for `mergeHouseStates`.
5. **Wire `startHouseSync`**: find where `startBackgroundResearch`/convex sync context is set in `src/routes/editor/index.tsx` (`useConvexClient` usage). Add ONE `useVisibleTask$` (or one line in an existing client-ready task) that starts it with cleanup. Keep the diff to a few lines.
6. **`src/utils/brief-history.ts`**:
   - `archiveBriefEdition(folioId, brief, provenance?: { source: LedgerSource; reason?: string })`.
   - Store the provenance on the edition (`BriefEdition.source?`, `BriefEdition.reason?`).
   - After archiving, call `appendLedger` from `house-store.ts` with one entry per changed dossier field (`layer: "folio"`, `ownerRef: folioId`, from/to strings). Compare the previous and next briefs, which means passing the next brief too: change `saveProjectBriefForFolio` in `src/utils/anti-tabula-rasa.ts` to accept optional provenance and pass it through. Default source is `"refine"`.
   - Existing callers must keep compiling unchanged.
7. **`src/utils/ai-client.ts`**: add `runClientDossierAmend({ field, label, current, excerpt, dossier }, settings): Promise<string | null>`.
   - Model it on `runClientDossierCheck` (~line 3619): `resolveFeatureConfig(settings, "dossier-check")`, `createModel`, `generateTrackedText`.
   - It returns ONE revised line (≤ 240 chars) for that dossier field, describing what the recent draft `excerpt` is actually doing.
   - Strip quotes and reasoning tags; return null on failure.
   - Add a small test if there's an existing pattern for mocking these.

## Done means
- `bunx tsc --noEmit -p .` has no NEW errors in your files. Check with `bun run build.types 2>&1 | grep -E "house|brief-history|anti-tabula|ai-client"`.
- Your tests pass when run individually: `bun test src/utils/house-sync.test.ts`, and the convex test via the repo's vitest setup (see `vitest.config.ts` and how `convex/userComments.test.ts` runs).
- If `npx convex codegen` can't run offline, add the `house` module to `convex/_generated/api.d.ts` by hand, following the existing entries.
- End with a short report: files changed, test commands and their results, anything left undone.
I’ll read the required guidance, then implement the backend and sync within the listed files, preserving the other agent’s work and unrelated changes.

I’m applying the Convex skill’s validator and indexed-query guidance. The existing House types match the requested row layout. I’ll keep the merge rule explicit: the house timestamp selects house and collections, while charter items and ledger entries merge independently.

The backend now has owner-scoped tables, bounded snapshot validation, exact replacement, and append-only ledger writes. Next I’ll add sync and provenance. The sync will send ledger entries in batches of 200 so older local entries aren’t dropped by the per-call limit.

The four merge tests and six Convex tests pass, including account isolation and ledger pagination. The typecheck is still running. I’m also checking the provenance flow and generated API declaration before the final review.

The full typecheck passed. Code generation failed because the environment couldn’t reach the network, so I added the `house` entry to `api.d.ts` by hand as requested. The new AI test hit a Qwik initialization error; I’m adjusting the test setup and will rerun it.

Implemented the House backend, sync, provenance ledger, editor wiring, and dossier amendment helper.

Changed:
- `convex/{schema,house,house.test,account}.ts` and `_generated/api.d.ts`
- `src/utils/{house-sync,house-sync.test,brief-history,anti-tabula-rasa,ai-client,ai-client-dossier-amend.test}.ts`
- `src/routes/editor/index.tsx`

Validation:
- `bun test src/utils/house-sync.test.ts` — 4 passed
- `bunx vitest run convex/house.test.ts` — 6 passed
- `bun test src/utils/ai-client-dossier-amend.test.ts` — 2 passed
- `bun run build.types` and `bunx tsc --noEmit -p .` — passed
- `git diff --check` — passed

Codegen failed offline; added the API declaration manually. Deployment and browser sync verification remain untested. No commits made.
